title: Robust Error Bounds for Vector-Valued Kernel Ridge Regression
summary: While kernel-based learning methods for scalar-valued functions have been extensively studied, comparatively little work considers nonlinear vector-valued operators. Such operators with vector-valued outputs, e.g., state vectors and trajectories, commonly arise in system identification problems. In this paper, we study the problem of learning a vector-valued operator under the framework of vector-valued kernel ridge regression.
